feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Sudan's lost generation: War is stealing a generation of childhood
entry.summary: Three years of war have stolen childhood from millions of children in Sudan, leaving them displaced, hungry and fighting for survival instead of learning in a classroom.

entry.title: A postcard from Philadelphia's wild, forested trail system
entry.summary: NPR's Brian Mann sends an audio postcard from a hike through Philadelphia's wild, forested trail system, which winds through dense gritty neighborhoods.

entry.title: A new biography of Frank Capra tells the story of making 'It's a Wonderful Life'
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Sam Wasson about his new biography of legendary director Frank Capra.

entry.title: With Abbott out, what does the future look like for data centers in Texas?
entry.summary: Texas has been one of the most welcoming states for data centers, but that might change with a new governor coming in.

entry.title: Contrary to popular belief, foot traffic and spending at malls is up
entry.summary: This is the biggest shopping weekend for the American mall, which — despite widespread belief to the contrary — is not dying. One reason? Teens and tweens have rediscovered the hangout.

entry.title: Postmortem of AI ads
entry.summary: The data AI companies have been accumulating in this cycle will help serve future ads to hyper-specific audiences.

entry.title: Peter Gabriel is no longer worried if he's 'cool'
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with British singer-songwriter Peter Gabriel about his latest album, o\i.

entry.title: Writer Elizabeth Alexander on how she copes with fear
entry.summary: On Wild Card, famous guests answer questions that we don't always talk about. Writer Elizabeth Alexander talks about how she copes with fear.

entry.title: Some American farmers are betting big on ostrich meat
entry.summary: As beef prices rise, some Ostrich farmers are looking toward the big bird as a substitute. Chase Purdy, a Bloomberg freelancer, speaks with the show about why and how.

entry.title: Survivors of sexual abuse told lawmakers about their experiences on Roblox
entry.summary: Survivors and experts testified to a Senate Judiciary subcommittee on how predators groom children on the gaming platform Roblox. The company has blocked lawsuits with an arbitration clause kids sign.
